description: This file defines a mock API client for a streaming platform, including functions for user authentication, profile management, subscription handling, content catalog filtering, watchlist and history management, all backed by localStorage.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Asynchronous delay function returning a promise that resolves after specified milliseconds.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from localStorage.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets or removes the authentication token in localStorage.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user profile from localStorage.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Stores or removes the user profile in localStorage.

methods.name: filterCatalog
methods.description: Filters the mock catalog based on search query, genre, year, and sort order.
